description: This file defines a set of React components for an alert dialog UI, utilizing Radix UI primitives and custom styling utilities. It exports components such as AlertDialog, AlertDialogTrigger, AlertDialogContent, and others, to facilitate accessible and styled alert dialogs in a React application.

classes.name: AlertDialogOverlay
classes.description: A styled overlay component for the alert dialog, with animated fade-in and fade-out effects.

classes.name: AlertDialogContent
classes.description: The main content container for the alert dialog, positioned centrally with styling and animation.

classes.name: AlertDialogHeader
classes.description: A container for the header section of the alert dialog, typically including the title.

classes.name: AlertDialogFooter
classes.description: A container for the footer section of the alert dialog, typically including action buttons.

classes.name: AlertDialogTitle
classes.description: A styled title component for the alert dialog, using Radix UI's primitive title.

classes.name: AlertDialogDescription
classes.description: A styled description component for the alert dialog, providing additional information.

classes.name: AlertDialogAction
classes.description: A button component for confirming or proceeding actions within the dialog.

classes.name: AlertDialogCancel
classes.description: A button component for canceling or closing the dialog.

methods.name: React.forwardRef
methods.description: Used to create components that can accept refs, enabling imperative focus and other interactions.

methods.name: cn
methods.description: A utility function for conditionally combining class names.

methods.name: buttonVariants
methods.description: A utility function for applying style variants to button components.
